title: Appointed as Assistant
original: There is no need to worry yourself over my condition. I will strive to adapt to all minute physiological changes, and my work will not be impeded. I will continue to serve as your general physician.

title: Talk 1
original: The Sarcophagus's core device is precisely what keeps me alive, and for the time being I cannot move without it. This is a novel experience, paying close attention to my own condition. There are many matters I must re-familiarize myself with, and perhaps this time I will require your guidance.

title: Talk 2
original: With your combined effort to plot a course and lead Rhodes Island out of such dire straits, Amiya has grown into a mature leader, and I have never doubted Closure's talents or your strategic choices. We will not stop moving on account of one individual's departure—our losses, too, have shaped Rhodes Island into what we are today.

title: Talk 3
original: I am glad Mon3tr has managed to assimilate into Rhodes Island in her current form. She may be literally one-of-a-kind, but she is thankfully not alone here. She will not forget the duty we once carried on our shoulders, so you can trust her implicitly. She will stay by your side for much longer.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Priestess has handed her choice to you, and will not menace us for the time being. The Originium Incident has ripped open the wounds hidden by this land, and without a leader, despair could very well destroy us all before disaster has a chance to strike. No matter the era, civilization's greatest enemy has always been humanity itself.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Do you still feel lost, even now? One can only find meaning in one's existence provided a place to stand—life's inherent nature; but for me, that place is a duty, a commitment. I no longer question what my life is for, as the individual by the name of Kal'tsit has found herself at the end of her journey.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Thinking back on those farewells I could neither forget nor undo… I never expected a second shot at life. And I am grateful. The time that passed for me was something like a dream, while the rest of you were waiting in torment. Forgive me... you are correct, a parting like that would not be fair to anyone.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Our conversations will no longer be restricted, for I have no more secrets to hide from you. I will gladly share my experiences from past millennia, though I fear those thoughts and feelings will be hard to put into words. Very well, I will tell you as many stories as I can before the memories fade.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: I will never forget what someone told me of life and love, and finally, I can give an answer with this body before it expires. I will patiently endure time's pressure on me, and stay true to my oath til my next and final death do us part.

title: Idle
original: Fortunately… this is not just another dream.

title: Onboard
original: Dr. {@nickname}…?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: Things will only get harsher in the future, so we ought to draw as much experience as possible.

title: Promotion 1
original: You have many companions you can depend on. As a leader, you should get used to relying on them for your strength.

title: Promotion 2
original: You no longer need my guidance, while Rhodes Island and this great land will have even greater need of you. Do not forget your initial matter of debate, Doctor: 'Find yourself.'

title: Added to Squad
original: I can join the planning for our first-aid measures.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Sure thing.

title: Depart
original: Mon3tr, there is no need to worry. You're better off staying here to protect Doctor.

title: Begin Operation
original: Minimize casualties, by all means. We must preserve every shred of hope left on this land.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Treatment preparations complete.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I trust you.

title: Deployment 1
original: Wide-range healing unit deployed.

title: Deployment 2
original: I'll keep the Operators safe. Focus on command.

title: In Battle 1
original: Executing Ark Life Protocol.

title: In Battle 2
original: Command: Restore.

title: In Battle 3
original: Mon3tr, I need you to protect the wounded.

title: In Battle 4
original: Don't be afraid, this power will only be used to heal.

title: 4-star Result
original: Perhaps we'll manage to see it… the future that belongs to all the people.

title: 3-star Result
original: No casualties reported.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: The combat situation has been complicated, and we cannot avoid unexpected variables in our plans. But there are still ways to remedy them.

title: Operation Failure
original: Let the others retreat first. Mon3tr, I need you to help me with the cleanup operation.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Same as it ever was.

title: Tap
original: You don't have to check up on me every minute, this body is no different to the others.

title: Trust Tap
original: If my condition really does concern you, then I will tell you, I am fine.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: New Year's has come again, and this time I feel the flow of time passing through my body. This is not dread, for the limitations of time are what make it valuable, and perhaps it is through experiences like these that I can live a more normal life. Dr. {@nickname}, I wish you good health in the new year.

title: Greeting
original: I am here, Dr. {@nickname}.

title: Birthday
original: Time has wiped away all traces of the world you once belonged to, and even the calendar system that once counted life's passage no longer exists. So, I would rather offer you my blessings the way people do on this great land. I hope it will grant you faith that even on your long and treacherous journey, you were and are never alone.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Rhodes Island's ideals have indeed united many. Even after suffering countless unbearable hardships, there are still those who yearn for a hopeful future. Regardless of whether we can truly overcome all of this suffering, the vision we carry on our shoulders ultimately belongs to all of Terra, and it ought to be remembered.
